content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a challenge to a dropped limb by noting no live link remains, not by weighing a live link's pressed witnesses chain against chain.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "pressed against a link: (1) a dropped limb is no longer a live link, so K-C's chain-vs-chain collision is not triggered; (2) the dropped limb still counts as a pressed link for K-C.", "why": "Because the challenged curse limb was dropped, there is no live link for K-C's chain-vs-chain weighing; the judge did not use a verse-by-verse stating-verse test."}
